trigger: Player enters the grand atrium in Room 01 and encounters the greeter robot.

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: The receptionist drone just offered us 'complimentary beige smocks'!

lines.speaker: manya
lines.text: I'd rather be erased than wear beige linen! Where is my lavender aesthetic?!

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: Bhai, mind the leather jacket. Let me smooth-talk this receptionist. Le re!

lines.speaker: mishthi
lines.text: As if I care about corporate dress codes, but beige linen is a sartorial crime.
